experiment: QNATIVE-1 guarded source-native natural-question train/dev compiler
status: PROSPECTIVE; commit protocol and producer/verifier before any selected labels or projection
hypothesis: Existing independently custodied QASPER train/dev papers can emit truthful native Boolean, answerability, evidence retrieval and extraction DecisionIR with original annotations in separate targets/provenance, unchanged component membership and no sealed-label access. Compiler correctness and coverage only, not model quality.

source.license_class: shipping-train as recorded: source-specific CC-BY-4.0 grant; attribution and modification notice retained; underlying full-paper republication rights remain under review; no raw Git redistribution
source.exposure: Public QASPER and possible LongBench/SCROLLS overlap; unknown pretrained membership; not universally fresh
source.citation: Dasigi et al. (2021), A Dataset of Information-Seeking Questions and Answers Anchored in Research Papers

data.allocation: Reuse exact existing source_groups.final_split and component_id; no resplit, cap, filtering by quality, moved phase or model labels. Every selected paper/question remains in a private source census even if a task is unlabelled.

access.custodian: Read-only query-only SQLite, table/column authorizer; fixed parameterized queries join papers/questions/annotations through source_groups.final_split=? and allow train/dev only. Reject unknown/sealed roles before protocol/database/file access. Never SELECT payload_json, annotation_json, answer_json, worker_id_json, questions from unselected papers, or sealed labels. Do not return SQLite handles or expose mixed database rows to selectors. Hash unchanged database before/after.
access.selector: open_phase(phase,stream=serving) rejects non-train/dev before any file access; require completed manifest, exact current producer/protocol and original-source pins, independent PASS receipt tied to manifest and hashed rooted stream. Four streams serving/decisions/targets/provenance; no final/calibration export. Producer gate checks git committed exact files before DB access.
access.reader_boundary: Operational phase and column separation; not a sandbox against a principal with arbitrary filesystem access.

projection.state: Only original title, abstract, full_text. Ordered nonempty string blocks: title, abstract, each section heading and paragraph. IDs title, abstract, section:%04d:heading, section:%04d:paragraph:%04d (source positions retained); full_text list-of-sections or columnar section_name/paragraphs supported. Preserve wording/order; no normalization, truncation, figures, source questions, labels or annotations in state. If no text exists, one empty document block and explicit missingness. All source-only blocks are the label-independent retrieval catalogue, including duplicates at distinct positions.
projection.question: Original string question; refuse malformed present non-string question. Source-only question identity hashes [source ID, revision, group_id, paper_id, source_partition, question ordinal, endpoint]. Gold and output text never enter IDs.

boolean.question: Original question unchanged
boolean.eligibility: Emit only when at least one annotation contains native yes_no of exact Python/JSON Boolean type. Do not treat arbitrary non-Boolean questions as yes/no tasks. All other questions remain in source census/coverage; null/absent is not False. Conflicting unanswerable/yes_no annotations are preserved and explicitly flagged, not silently removed.
boolean.target: Separate per-annotation original presence, native value and observed mask; counts[false,true], empirical retained-annotation distribution and observed_raters; no majority or rounded gold. IR.gold is all IDs with nonzero counts; filtered native task distribution, not population truth probability.

answerability.question_prefix: Can the following question be answered using this paper?
answerability.eligibility: Every source question, including unlabelled ones
answerability.target: Exact complement of each observed native Boolean unanswerable; preserve original value/presence/missingness and mapped value. Null/absent never becomes answerable or unanswerable. Counts/distribution as native Boolean; explicit transformed-source target, not generic arbitrary Boolean truth.

evidence.question_prefix: Which passages support an answer to the following question?
evidence.candidates: Every source-only state block with original text/ID; no gold-dependent shortlist or candidate addition
evidence.target: Retain original ordered per-annotation evidence arrays and null/absent distinction. Exact byte-equal matching to all source blocks; duplicates map to all positions. No fuzzy matching or marker stripping. Preserve every unmatched native evidence string, including excluded figure/table references; report full/mixed/no catalogue support. IR.gold/evidence include only resolvable block IDs; native target ledger retains all gold and incomplete support. Unmatched gold cannot be dropped from any future quality denominator.

extraction.question: Original question unchanged
extraction.candidates: Empty; never infer candidates from gold answers
extraction.target: Retain ordered original per-annotation extractive_spans and null/absent distinction, and all exact substring occurrences within every source block with block_id/start/end. Retain unmatched spans; no normalization, alias synthesis or free-form-to-extractive conversion. Native free_form_answer is separate provenance only. IR.gold empty; IR.evidence only exact resolved span positions.

projection.annotations: Only exact bool is a present Boolean; non-null wrong types fail closed. Evidence/extractive_spans must be list[str] when present non-null; invalid present types fail closed. Original arrays/order/presence values retained; worker/annotation IDs remain in original custody, not serving or stdout. Annotation ordinal is local provenance, never independent sample n.
projection.serving: Pinned IR renderer, locale=en. Strict source-only task/question/state/candidate projection; no gold/evidence/provenance/targets/metadata in serving. IR stream is non-serving and may contain gold evidence.
projection.serialization: Canonical finite UTF-8 JSON sorted keys and compact separators, lists source order; deterministic gzip mtime0; refuse output overwrite/incomplete manifest; failure artifacts retained outside selector surface.

controls: Independent original-field target/IR/serving reconstruction without producer projection helper
Exact membership and source/question/annotation denominators; deterministic ordered group/component/decision hashes
Sealed/unknown role and invalid stream denial before opening source or output
Negative tamper cases: source/stream/manifest/receipt changes rejected; nullable/wrong-type Bool boundaries, evidence duplicates/unmatched, extractive offsets, source-only state
No cross-role component; original DB hash unchanged; full unlabelled and partial-support coverage retained

gates.custody: Exact pinned artifacts and unchanged source database
gates.membership: Exact all train/dev counts and original group hash; no moved components
gates.projection: Full-population exact reconstruction of fields, target masks/distributions/offsets, serving bytes and separated provenance
gates.access: All guarded negative controls reject before prohibited access

resources.streaming: One selected paper at a time; bounded arrays and gzip writers

statistics: Deterministic population reconstruction/coverage; no quality CIs. Statistical unit for future question results is component/paper, never annotation or repeated question.
failure: Fail closed on hashes, schema, membership/access or present wrong types; retain partial/failure receipt; fix implementation-only prospectively with same frozen source allocation. Missing labels and unmatched evidence/spans are truthful coverage, not invented targets or quality failures.
next_branch: Verified projection and coverage allow a separately preregistered source-native variable-question/Boolean/evidence DEV mechanism. Audit retained task support and public exposure before selecting any architecture, calibrating or using long-document strata. Existing intent NATIVE-2 runs and protocol remain untouched.
